note: SRA on a 190-acre lake 3 mi west of Tekamah. Two loops off the park road: Muskrat (sites 02-22) and Eckdahl (25-43, on the slope above the swim beach and boat ramps). 43 Electric Plus sites and 25 basic non-electric sites. Water from spigots; ReserveAmerica lists a water hookup at sites 28 and 39 only. Primitive restrooms, swim beach. --Claude
summary: ReserveAmerica confirms 50 A Electric Plus, 65-ft back-in gravel pads, 31 reservable sites in two loops (Muskrat, Eckdahl), 180-day window; phone (402)374-1727 found. water false cleared (two sites tagged water hookup). On NAIP with the RA GIS points: the Muskrat loop (41.7620-41.7628, -96.3005 to -96.2992) backs onto a treed strip and a marsh/algae arm ~60-80 m north, not open lake. The Eckdahl loop (41.7602-41.7611, -96.2967 to -96.2944) is on an open slope above the swim beach and boat ramps; the nearest open water is ~120-150 m NE across mown grass and the sand beach, so a view but no apron. Lakeview fits Eckdahl; Muskrat on its own would be not waterfront. If AWH wants the weaker loop to govern, it goes down.
